title: ResearchOS local client protocol v2; implementation NOT_STARTED
$comment: v2 preserves all original 12 method names and payload shapes. Typed results, strict event payloads and added methods require protocol negotiation; v1 cannot be silently accepted as v2. Native* definitions are transient IPC schemas and intentionally excluded from protocol messages. See 22_CLIENT_INTERFACE_DETAILS.md.

AttachPayload.description: false is read-only. true is an explicit acquire/renew/same-OS-principal takeover request: expected_revision required, writer_epoch must be null. Host authorizes, compares revisions, pauses and settles active work before atomic owner transfer; it never cancels or resumes work implicitly.

RelativePath.description: Schema rejects common escapes; host MUST canonicalize against the registered root and reject symlink/junction/ADS/UNC escapes at access time.

NativeCredentialImportRequest.$comment: Transient trusted settings/preload or CLI secret prompt only. Never CommandEnvelope, durable queue, journal, telemetry, events, artifacts or logs. No get-secret operation exists.
